items.claim: [r33-1] Adds picker reads a non-actor head as Participant
items.note: (no longer applies). Commit e96f89bf7c fixed it. `headKind` in `apps/chart/src/SequencePanel.tsx` now returns null for any outline other than actor or rect, so the picker shows no value for such a head and choosing Participant applies. The test "shows no figure for a head the Adds picker does not name, so choosing Participant applies" in `apps/chart/src/SequencePanel.test.tsx` covers it with a cylinder head.

items.claim: The Sequence panel's Adds and Arrow pickers showed a value for a figure or arrow they don't name, so choosing it changed nothing
The Sequence pickers and the Activates/Deactivates selects showed only the first selected item's value, so a mixed selection couldn't be set to it
File › Export turned a format off because of a page it would never write
items.note: I added a `page` option to `scenePageKinds`, so a one-page format like DOT now asks only about the page in view. That needed a `@weasel-js/diagram-formats` changeset (minor, `api`). I made the strict call for whole-document formats like Draw-style XML: they stay off while any page holds a kind they can't write, even though the writer would just leave that page out with a warning. The call is recorded in `docs/unruled.md` under "Audit round thirty-three".

items.claim: The Data panel kept the last chart's error note and open rows when the selection moved to another chart
The page tabs' "+" button added a blank page, not "a page of the chart's own type" as its doc says
items.note: It now goes through `addChartPage` with the chart type's template, as Page › Add Page… does. This brings back that type's stencil groups even if the user had hidden them, matching Add Page.

items.claim: Page Setup's target page was never cleared when the page went away, so a redo reopened the dialog
